description: Phase 3 sweep S12 (E14c): the S11 circuits and sizes, (T, tau) = (5, 2), (5, 3), (6, 4), trained with L-BFGS on the shot-free SWAP-test loss (central-difference gradient, at most 2000 iterations, small positive initial angles U(0, 0.3)) instead of SPSA with a fixed learning rate. Purpose: remove the optimizer and the learning rate from the comparison of circuit B (interfering) with circuit A and the logistic baseline. Baselines are rerun under the same labels; the training keys do not affect them. Evaluation matrix: no winner selected.

evaluation.split: test = chronological last 20 % of T + horizon windows
evaluation.checkpoint: final iteration for quantum models; validation-selected refit for baselines
evaluation.aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over seeds; paired-by-seed differences with a 95 % t interval
evaluation.tie_rule: a paired difference whose 95 % interval contains 0 is reported as not distinguishable
